name: Customer Hierarchy Report
query:
SELECT 
    child_customer.customer_group AS "Customer Group:Group:150",
    parent_customer.name AS "Parent Customer:Link/Customer:200",
    child_customer.name AS "Child Customer:Link/Customer:200",
    child_customer.customer_name AS "Child Customer Name",
    child_customer.territory AS "Territory"
FROM 
    `tabCustomer` AS child_customer
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabCustomer` AS parent_customer 
ON 
    child_customer.custom_parent_company = parent_customer.name
WHERE 
    child_customer.custom_is_child_company = 1
ORDER BY 
    child_customer.customer_group, parent_customer.name, child_customer.name;
